notes: This portable C++ TCK scenario uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador API, the standard library, and adapter-supplied application FOM, standard MIM, provider package, endpoint, and callback configuration. It sends the standard federate-level HLAsetSwitches interaction with HLAserviceReporting true and false, then verifies the standard public Service Reporting switch getter. It does not rely on provider-specific names, registries, headers, or internal switch state.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador standard-MIM interaction and parameter lookup, receive-order sendInteraction, Service Reporting switch query, and federation lifecycle
